title: All Will Be Crooked
summary: The ritual was lost and the realm reborn crooked.

epilogue.title: Wickermoor
epilogue.text: Wickermoor's houses are grown through with roots, and its Round is a bog of antlers and hares. The folk who remain wear the same smile.

epilogue.title: Foxwillow
epilogue.text: Foxwillow's folk were reborn as crows, and wheel above the fields they once farmed, calling in a language only the wind keeps.

epilogue.title: The Green Queen Inn
epilogue.text: The Green Queen Inn has become a hall of antlers. The bar is open and everyone is served, and nobody is able to leave.

epilogue.title: Dawn's Gate
epilogue.text: Dawn's Gate bends toward the crooked moon at every prayer. The faith kept its liturgy and lost its listeners.

epilogue.title: Murkwater Bend
epilogue.text: Murkwater Bend is a swamp that has learned to grin. Vander Boone's promises went down with the boom.

epilogue.title: The Lord and Lady
epilogue.text: Phillip and Adela Druskenvald are gone, taken up in the tree. Their house on the hill is a mouth.

epilogue.title: The Queen Unbound
epilogue.text: Kehlenn rises toward the moon, and the moon smiles all the way down. The valley is hers to remake, and she begins with the faces.

epilogue.title: The Last Ride
epilogue.text: No train comes out of the fog for those who stay. The Vagrant plays one verse for them on his fiddle, somewhere else.
